behaviors_asserted: AWS API Gateway v2 Websocket proxy event delivered to the Lambda has no event.httpMethod and includes a body.
When event.httpMethod is undefined, EventV1Processor cannot extract a valid HTTP method (causing the downstream Request creation error).
Proposed fix: EventV1Processor.getMethod should return event.httpMethod || 'POST'.

values_specified.observed_error_message: Request with GET/HEAD method cannot have body.
